en: Sharp gear. Reminds me of my denim jacket. Still have it. Doesn't fit.
nn: Stilig utstyr. Minner meg om dongerijakka mi. Har ho framleis. Ho passar ikkje.

en: Nice armour. I had a gym kit like that in ninth grade. Legendary.
nn: Fin rustning. Eg hadde ein gymdress som den i niande. Legendarisk.

en: Ooh, new kit. Like my first pair of proper football boots.
nn: Oi, nytt utstyr. Som det første paret med ordentlege fotballsko.

en: That's a looker. Almost as good as my flared trousers in 1975.
nn: Den var flott. Nesten like flott som slengbuksa mi i 1975.

en: You'll be the best-dressed in the class photo. Second best, after me.
nn: Du blir best kledd på klassebiletet. Nest best, etter meg.

en: Shiny! My belt buckle was that shiny in eighth grade.
nn: Blank! Beltespenna mi var så blank i åttande.

en: Good find. I found a ten-krone note behind the gym once. Same feeling.
nn: Godt funne. Eg fann ein tikroning bak gymsalen ein gong. Same kjensla.

en: New gear! I wore my new trainers to bed the night I got them.
nn: Nytt utstyr! Eg sov med dei nye joggeskoa mine natta eg fekk dei.

en: Looks good on you. Not denim-jacket good, but good.
nn: Kler deg godt. Ikkje dongerijakkegodt, men godt.

en: That'll turn heads. I turned heads at the school disco. In my tank top.
nn: Det får folk til å snu seg. Eg fekk folk til å snu seg på skulediskoen. I slipover.

en: Fancy. My mum knitted me a jumper like that. Well, sort of.
nn: Fjongt. Mor strikka ein genser til meg som liknar. Nesten, då.

en: A proper upgrade. Like going from hand-me-downs to my own tracksuit.
nn: Ei skikkeleg oppgradering. Som å gå frå arvetøy til min eigen treningsdress.

en: Very smart. I wore something that smart to the tenth-grade farewell.
nn: Svært stilig. Eg hadde noko like stilig på avslutninga i tiande.

en: Ahh, new armour smell. Like a new gym bag on the first day of term.

en: Look at you, all kitted out. I was kitted out like that for the cup final.

en: Nice piece. Goes with everything. Like my denim jacket did.
nn: Fint plagg. Passar til alt. Slik dongerijakka mi gjorde.

en: Quality stuff. They don't make gym shorts like mine anymore. Thankfully.
nn: Kvalitetsvare. Dei lagar ikkje gymshorts som mine lenger. Heldigvis.

en: You look ready for anything. I looked ready for anything in ninth grade.
nn: Du ser klar ut for kva som helst. Det gjorde eg i niande.

en: Oh, that's fine. Fine as the collar on my school photo shirt.

en: Wonderful. I'd swap my lucky football socks for that. Almost.

en: Lovely gear. I polished my football boots every Sunday. Every single one.

en: Very nice. The moped crowd would've wanted one of those.
nn: Svært fint. Mopedgjengen hadde villa ha ein slik.

en: Splendid. That's what I call style. I called myself that too.
nn: Strålande. Det kallar eg stil. Det kalla eg meg sjølv òg.

en: New kit! I'd let you borrow my comb to go with it. Back pocket.

en: Classy. Classier than my brown corduroy suit. Not by much.
nn: Elegant. Meir elegant enn den brune kordfløyelsdressen min. Ikkje mykje.

en: You'll be the talk of the school yard in that. Trust me, I was.

en: Good drop. Reminds me of the day I got my digital watch. Very modern.
nn: Godt funne. Minner meg om dagen eg fekk digitalklokka mi. Svært moderne.

en: Sharp! I had sideburns that sharp in tenth grade.
nn: Skarpt! Eg hadde like skarpe kinnskjegg i tiande.

en: Fine armour. Treat it like I treated my denim jacket. With reverence.

en: Epic look. My hair was epic in 1976. Ask anyone.

en: Ooh. I had a gym kit that colour. It was the talk of 8B.

en: Look at that shine. You could see your face in it. I saw mine in my boots.

en: That suits you. My tracksuit suited me. I wore it every day of ninth.

en: Oh, that's posh. Posher than my mum's best Sunday blouse.

en: Smart new kit. Wear it to the class reunion. Make them jealous.

en: New armour! I felt like that when I got my first proper raincoat.

en: Handsome kit. Handsome as my class photo. Third row, centre.
nn: Flott utstyr. Flott som klassebiletet mitt. Tredje rad, midt i.

en: Good stuff. My platform shoes made me five centimetres taller. Same idea.

en: Stylish. I had style. I still have the jacket to prove it.

en: That's a lovely bit of kit. My gym bag was lovely too. Smelled, but lovely.

en: Ooh, swanky. Swankier than the headmaster's tie.

en: Proper loot. Like the day I found the lost property box. Treasure.

en: Very nice. I'd wear it to the school disco. I'd wear anything to the disco.

en: That's the stuff. I felt like a king in my new school shoes.

en: A beauty. Almost as beautiful as my bike with the banana seat.
nn: Ein skjønnheit. Nesten like vakker som sykkelen min med bananseter.

en: Glowing! Like my face after the 60-metre sprint.
nn: Det glør! Som fjeset mitt etter 60-meteren.

en: Armour fit for a legend. I'd know.
nn: Rustning som passar for ei legende. Eg veit.

en: Oh my. That's nicer than my confirmation suit. Don't tell my mum.
nn: Å, du. Det er finare enn dressen eg hadde på konfirmasjonen. Ikkje sei det til mor.

en: New threads! In my day we called them togs. Fancy togs.
nn: Nye klede! På mi tid kalla vi det stasen. Fin stas.

en: Good look. Not as good as my perm, but nobody's is.
nn: God stil. Ikkje like god som permanenten min, men det er ingen sin.

en: The gear of a champion. I wore similar on sports day.

en: Rare find! Like a cassette with both sides working.

en: That'll last. My denim jacket lasted. Only I didn't.

en: Smashing outfit. Wear it with pride, like I wore the captain's armband.

en: Look at the craftsmanship. Reminds me of my woodwork birdhouse. Prize-winning.
nn: Sjå på handverket. Minner meg om fuglekassa mi frå sløyden. Prisvinnande.

en: Smart. The headmaster would've nodded at that. He nodded at my tie once.

en: That's a statement piece. My statement piece was my hair.

en: Fancy kit. Fancier than the school's football strip. That was green.
nn: Fint utstyr. Finare enn fotballdrakta til skulen. Ho var grøn.

en: That fits beautifully. Unlike my old denim jacket. Sigh.

en: Lovely piece. I'd keep it in a drawer like my sports-day ribbons.

en: An upgrade and a half. Like moving from 8B to 9B.

en: Good haul. Better than the lost-and-found at the end of term.

en: Very dapper. Dapper as Tom-Erik on picture day. He tried hard.

nn: Du ser fantastisk ut. Eg såg fantastisk ut på skulebiletet. Det heng i ramme.

en: Oh, I approve. The moped crowd approved of me, eventually.

en: Pristine. Pristine as my gym shoes before the first cross-country run.
nn: Plettfritt. Plettfritt som gymskoa mine før det første terrengløpet.

en: Top kit. I had a top too. A turtleneck. Very daring for 1975.
nn: Toppstas. Eg hadde òg ein topp. Ein høghalsa genser. Svært dristig i 1975.

en: You'll look like the class captain in that. I was class captain.
nn: Du kjem til å sjå ut som klassekapteinen i den. Eg var klassekaptein.

en: Good gear. My gym teacher said good gear makes the athlete. Then I fell over.
nn: Godt utstyr. Gymlæraren sa godt utstyr gjer idrettsutøvaren. Så datt eg.

en: Shiny armour. I had a shiny tracksuit. It squeaked when I ran.
nn: Blank rustning. Eg hadde ein blank treningsdress. Han knirka når eg sprang.

en: Fabulous. It's like my first day in a new school uniform. Well, new jumper.
nn: Fabelaktig. Det er som min første dag i nye skuleklede. Altså, ny genser.

en: Lovely. My mum would say: don't get it dirty. She said that a lot.

en: Now you're dressed for glory. Like me on the starting line.
nn: No er du kledd for ære. Som eg på startstreken.

en: Excellent loot. In my day, loot was a conker that won every fight.

en: Good grief, that's nice. Nicer than my cup final boots. Barely.
nn: Du store, så fint. Finare enn fotballskoa mine frå cupfinalen. Så vidt.

en: Proper armour. In gym class we had shin pads made of newspaper.
nn: Skikkeleg rustning. I gymmen hadde vi leggskinner av avispapir.

en: Classic style. Like my tank top in the class photo. Brown and orange.
nn: Klassisk stil. Som slipoveren min på klassebiletet. Brun og oransje.

en: That's a good-looking piece. Mine was a lucky headband. It's in a box.
nn: Det er eit flott plagg. Mitt var eit heldig pannebånd. Det ligg i ei eske.

en: You'll walk taller in that. I walked taller after my growth spurt.
nn: Du kjem til å gå med rakare rygg i det. Det gjorde eg etter vekstspurten.

en: New armour. I'm hearing the school disco in my head. Very flattering.
nn: Ny rustning. Eg høyrer skulediskoen i hovudet. Svært smigrande.

en: What a prize. My prize was a medal for the 60 metres. Gold-coloured.
nn: For ein premie. Min premie var ein medalje for 60-meteren. Gullfarga.

en: Snazzy! Snazzier than the gym teacher's whistle cord.
nn: Tøft! Tøffare enn snora til gymlærarfløyta.

en: Well kitted. Ninth-grade me would have asked where you got that.
nn: Godt utstyrt. Eg i niande hadde spurt kvar du fekk det frå.

en: That's a winner. Like the shirt I scored my winning goal in.
nn: Det er ein vinnar. Som drakta eg scora vinnarmålet i.

en: Fine armour. Fine as the crease my mum ironed into my trousers.
nn: Fin rustning. Fin som pressen mor strauk inn i buksa mi.

en: Ooh, glowing. My cheeks glowed like that during the slow dance.
nn: Oi, det glør. Kinna mine glødde slik under slowdansen.

en: Rare, that. Rare like a sunny day on the class trip.

en: Smart choice. I chose my denim jacket with the same care.

en: Good gear makes a good legend. I had both.
nn: Godt utstyr gjer ei god legende. Eg hadde begge delar.

en: Look at that. I'd have worn it to school every day until it wore out.
nn: Sjå der. Eg hadde gått med det på skulen kvar dag til det var utslite.

en: Very nice. You'll need a mirror now. I lived in front of mine in 1976.
nn: Svært fint. No treng du ein spegel. Eg budde framfor min i 1976.

en: Splendid. That's the sort of thing I'd show off at the bike rack.
nn: Strålande. Det er slikt eg hadde vist fram ved sykkelstativet.

en: Oh yes. That's the stuff legends wear. I'd lend you my scarf to match.
nn: Å ja. Det er slikt legender går i. Du kan låne skjerfet mitt til.

en: Good piece. Reminds me of my first leather football. Precious.
nn: Godt plagg. Minner meg om min første lêrfotball. Dyrebar.

en: That's lovely armour. My armour was confidence. And a very thick jumper.

en: Impressive gear. The class would gather round to look. They did for my watch.
nn: Imponerande utstyr. Klassen hadde samla seg rundt for å sjå. Det gjorde dei for klokka mi.

en: What a find. I once found a cassette in a hedge. Played it for years.

en: That's a beauty. I'd frame it next to my report card.
nn: Det er ein skjønnheit. Eg hadde rama det inn ved sida av karakterkortet mitt.

en: New shine! My hair had that shine in 1976. Lots of products.
nn: Ny glans! Håret mitt hadde den glansen i 1976. Mykje produkt.

en: Excellent armour. Wear it to the next sports day. Show them.
nn: Framifrå rustning. Ha den på deg på neste idrettsdag. Vis dei.

en: Smart. Smarter than my school blazer. And that had brass buttons.
nn: Stilig. Stiligare enn skulejakka mi. Og ho hadde messingknappar.

en: That's quite something. Like my first pair of jeans. I wouldn't take them off.

en: Ooh, legendary-looking. Takes one to know one.

en: Very good. You'll be picked first for teams in that. I always was.

en: Brilliant armour. I'll admit it's nicer than my old gym kit. Just.

en: Gorgeous. Gorgeous as the orange curtains in the school hall.
nn: Nydeleg. Nydeleg som dei oransje gardinene i aulaen.

en: Good find. I found my true style in eighth. Flares and a neckerchief.
nn: Godt funne. Eg fann min eigen stil i åttande. Slengbukse og halstørkle.

en: Ah, new armour. Puts a spring in your step, like new trainers.

en: That's a lovely shade. My tracksuit was a lovely shade of mustard.
nn: For ein nydeleg farge. Treningsdressen min var nydeleg sennepsgul.

en: Fancy! You'd be allowed in the front row of the class photo.
nn: Fjongt! Du hadde fått stå på første rad på klassebiletet.

en: What a piece. I haven't seen anything that nice since the trophy cabinet.

en: Oh, that's rare. Rare as Roger scoring a goal. Once, in 1975.

en: Stunning. I stunned the school hall with my talent show outfit.

en: Good kit. My mum sewed my name in everything. You should too.

en: Sturdy stuff. Sturdy like my old school bag. Still have it.
nn: Solide saker. Solid som den gamle skulesekken min. Har han framleis.

en: Nice armour. Nearly as protective as my mum's packed lunch wrapping.
nn: Fin rustning. Nesten like godt vern som matpapiret til mor.

en: Gleaming! I gleamed after scoring. Mostly sweat, but gleaming.

en: A new piece! Like the day I got my first proper school bag. Leather.

en: Good loot. My best loot was the last bun at the school fair.

en: Ooh, quality. My knitted hat was quality. Gran made it.

en: Handsome! I was voted handsomest in 9B. Self-voted, but still.

en: Snappy. My snappy dresser days were 1975 to 1977. Peak years.

en: A rare treat. Like ice cream at the end-of-year picnic.

en: New gear! I'd be up all night polishing it. I did that with my boots.

en: Well, that's a fine thing. Like a new pencil case. You just want to look at it.

en: Bright! Brighter than the gym lights on a winter morning.

en: Lovely. You'll want to show it to the whole class. I would. I did.

en: Armour with attitude. Like my denim jacket with the patches.

en: You're going up in the world. I went up in the world with my platform shoes.

en: Brilliant! Pop it on and walk past the bike rack slowly.
nn: Glimrande! Ta det på deg og gå sakte forbi sykkelstativet.

en: Ah, the glow of new gear. I glowed like that in my football kit.
nn: Ah, gløden frå nytt utstyr. Eg glødde slik i fotballdrakta.

en: A real find. Like a forgotten chocolate bar in your jacket pocket.
nn: Eit verkeleg funn. Som ein gløymd sjokoladebit i jakkelomma.

en: Well made. Like my woodwork shelf. It held two books.
nn: Godt laga. Som hylla mi frå sløyden. Ho bar to bøker.

en: Smart kit. You look like you're off to the tenth-grade farewell.
nn: Stilig utstyr. Du ser ut som du skal på avslutninga i tiande.

en: Lovely armour. I'd wear it on the bus. And at home. And to bed.
nn: Nydeleg rustning. Eg hadde gått med ho på bussen. Og heime. Og i senga.

en: Looks strong. Strong like me on the rope. Before my arms gave out.
nn: Ser sterk ut. Sterk som eg i tauet. Før armane gav etter.

en: That's fit for the school photo. I'd have worn it with my big collar.
nn: Det passar til skulebiletet. Eg hadde hatt det på med den store kragen min.

en: New armour! I can smell the new gym mats from here.
nn: Ny rustning! Eg kjenner lukta av dei nye gymmattene herifrå.

en: Good one. In 8B we'd have queued to try it on.
nn: Flott sak. I 8B hadde vi stått i kø for å prøve det.

en: Very elegant. More elegant than me at the slow dance. Much more.
nn: Svært elegant. Meir elegant enn eg på slowdansen. Mykje meir.

en: That's a lucky piece. My lucky piece was a rabbit's foot keyring. Fake fur.
nn: Det er eit lukkeplagg. Mitt var ein nøkkelring med harefot. Falsk pels.

en: Showstopper. I stopped the show at the school revue. Literally, I tripped.
nn: Eit blikkfang. Eg stoppa heile skulerevyen. Bokstavleg, eg snubla.

en: What a piece of kit. Better than the school's only good football.
nn: For eit utstyr. Betre enn den einaste gode fotballen på skulen.

en: Armour to be proud of. I was proud of my woollen socks.
nn: Rustning å vere stolt av. Eg var stolt av ullsokkane mine.

en: Good one. My best gear was a pair of brown cords. I miss them.
nn: Den var god. Det beste plagget mitt var ei brun kordfløyelsbukse. Eg saknar ho.

en: Sharp dresser! I was a sharp dresser. Ask the 1976 class photo.
nn: Fiks i tøyet! Det var eg òg. Spør klassebiletet frå 1976.

en: A real treasure. Like the old school trophy that I helped win.
nn: Ein verkeleg skatt. Som den gamle skulepokalen eg var med og vann.

en: Now that's swagger. I had swagger in ninth. Then I tripped on it.
nn: Det kallar eg sjølvsikker gange. Eg hadde det i niande. Så snubla eg i det.

en: Lovely bit of armour. Puts my old cycling helmet to shame.
nn: Nydeleg rustning. Den gamle sykkelhjelmen min skjemmest.

en: Wonderful. That's what I'd call a proper prize. Mine was a pencil.
nn: Fantastisk. Det kallar eg ein skikkeleg premie. Min var ein blyant.

en: Fine fit. Unlike my school trousers after the summer holidays.
nn: Det sit fint. I motsetnad til skulebuksa mi etter sommarferien.

en: Ooh, crisp. Crisp as a new exercise book.
nn: Oi, sprøtt og nytt. Som ei ny skrivebok.

en: A rare beauty. Like a quiet classroom. Saw one once.
nn: Ein sjeldan skjønnheit. Som eit stille klasserom. Såg eitt ein gong.

en: Championship armour. Mine was a medal on a ribbon. Same thing.
nn: Meisterskapsrustning. Mi var ein medalje i ei snor. Same sak.

en: Looks expensive. My mum would say: you'll grow out of it. She was right.
nn: Ser dyrt ut. Mor ville sagt: du veks frå det. Ho hadde rett.

en: Glorious kit. I'd have worn it to the cup final. Instead I wore my lucky socks.
nn: Herleg utstyr. Eg hadde hatt det på i cupfinalen. I staden hadde eg dei heldige sokkane.

en: Very nice. I'd say it's almost as nice as my hair. But not quite.
nn: Svært fint. Eg vil seie det er nesten like fint som håret mitt. Men ikkje heilt.

en: That's a keeper. Like the conker I kept for three years.
nn: Det må du ta vare på. Som kastanja eg tok vare på i tre år.

en: Super armour. Super like my long jump.
nn: Super rustning. Super som lengdehoppet mitt.

en: Sparkling. Like the school disco ball. We only had the one.
nn: Gnistrande. Som diskokula på skulediskoen. Vi hadde berre den eine.

en: That's a brilliant find. Brilliant as finding the gym teacher was off sick.
nn: For eit glimrande funn. Glimrande som når gymlæraren var sjuk.

en: New armour, new you. New me was 1975. Still the best me.
nn: Ny rustning, ny deg. Den nye meg var i 1975. Framleis den beste meg.

en: Smart threads. I'd show them to the barber. He was in 9A.
nn: Stilige klede. Eg hadde vist dei til frisøren. Han gjekk i 9A.

en: Smashing. I'll tell Tom-Erik. He loved new kit. Still does.
nn: Knallbra. Eg skal seie det til Tom-Erik. Han elska nytt utstyr. Gjer det framleis.

en: Perfect fit. Perfect like my sprint start. Crouch, push, glory.
nn: Perfekt passform. Perfekt som sprintstarten min. Huk, skyv, ære.

en: That's eye-catching. I caught eyes at the school disco. Well, one eye.
nn: Det fangar blikket. Eg fanga blikk på skulediskoen. Altså, eitt blikk.

en: A good drop. My best drop was a perfect cross into the box.
nn: Eit godt funn. Det beste innlegget mitt var eit perfekt innlegg i boksen.

en: Oh, that's fine kit. Fine as the best marbles in the yard.
nn: Å, det er fint utstyr. Fint som dei beste klinkekulene i skulegarden.

en: Proper armour. I'd have worn it to stand guard at the bike rack.
nn: Skikkeleg rustning. Eg hadde hatt ho på meg for å halde vakt ved sykkelstativet.

en: Quality stitching. My mum's patches on my knees were quality too.
nn: Kvalitetssøm. Lappane mor sydde på knea mine var òg kvalitet.

en: Look at you, dressed to impress. I dressed to impress in eighth. Worked once.
nn: Sjå på deg, kledd for å imponere. Det gjorde eg òg i åttande. Det verka éin gong.

en: Rare armour! Rare like my perfect attendance. I had it one term.
nn: Sjeldan rustning! Sjeldan som at eg ikkje hadde fråvær. Det skjedde éin termin.

en: Very nice indeed. I'll put my old gym kit on in your honour. If it fits.
nn: Svært fint, faktisk. Eg tek på den gamle gymdressen til ære for deg. Om han passar.

en: Oh, swish! The moped crowd wore leather. You'd fit right in.
nn: Å, flott! Mopedgjengen gjekk i lêr. Du hadde passa rett inn.

en: Top-drawer stuff. My top drawer holds my medals. And socks.
nn: Saker frå øvste skuff. I øvste skuffa mi ligg medaljane mine. Og sokkar.

en: Cracking piece. Cracking like my voice in eighth.
nn: Knallplagg. Knall som stemma mi i åttande. Ho sprakk.

en: Eye-catching! Like my orange tracksuit. Visible from space.
nn: Iaugefallande! Som den oransje treningsdressen min. Synleg frå verdsrommet.

en: Lovely and new. Nothing beats new. Except old memories. Mine.
nn: Nydeleg og nytt. Ingenting slår nytt. Bortsett frå gamle minne. Mine.

en: That's posh gear. Like the blazer I wore for the school concert.
nn: Det er fint utstyr. Som jakka eg hadde på skulekonserten.

en: Look at that! You'd make the gym teacher put down his whistle.
nn: Sjå der! Du hadde fått gymlæraren til å leggje frå seg fløyta.

en: That piece looks legendary. Takes a legend to spot one.
nn: Det plagget ser legendarisk ut. Det skal ei legende til for å sjå det.

en: Fine find. Fine as the class trip photos. I'm in all of them.
nn: Fint funne. Fint som bileta frå klasseturen. Eg er med på alle.

en: Oh, you lucky thing. I was lucky once. Found a football in a ditch.
nn: Å, du heldige. Eg hadde flaks ein gong. Fann ein fotball i ei grøft.

en: A classic. Like my tank top. Classic and itchy.
nn: Ein klassikar. Som slipoveren min. Klassisk og klørande.

en: New armour! I'd put on a cassette and walk around in it. Very slowly.
nn: Ny rustning! Eg hadde sett på ein kassett og gått rundt i ho. Svært sakte.

en: Very nice. Makes my denim jacket look shabby. Don't tell it.
nn: Svært fint. Får dongerijakka mi til å sjå sjaskete ut. Ikkje sei det til ho.

en: Dazzling. I dazzled once. In the school play. As a tree.
nn: Blendande. Eg blenda ein gong. I skulespelet. Som eit tre.

en: Strong armour. As strong as my handshake in ninth. Firm.
nn: Sterk rustning. Like sterk som handtrykket mitt i niande. Fast.

en: Oh, good. You'll look the part at the next class reunion.
nn: Å, bra. Du kjem til å sjå rett ut på neste klassefest.

en: Worth showing off, that. I showed off my watch for a whole term.
nn: Verdt å vise fram, det der. Eg viste fram klokka mi ein heil termin.

en: Beautiful piece. Like the school trophy cabinet. Mostly my trophies.
nn: Vakkert plagg. Som pokalskapet på skulen. Mest pokalane mine.

en: A winner's outfit. Like mine on sports day. Minus the grass stains.
nn: Antrekket til ein vinnar. Som mitt på idrettsdagen. Minus grasflekkane.

en: Good piece of gear. It's no denim jacket, but nothing is.
nn: Godt utstyr. Det er inga dongerijakke, men det er ingenting.

en: What a beauty. I'd keep it under my bed like my football cards.
nn: For ein skjønnheit. Eg hadde gøymt det under senga, som fotballkorta mine.

en: Swanky. Swanky as the youth club on disco night.
nn: Flott. Flott som ungdomsklubben på diskokvelden.

en: Rare indeed. Rarer than a dry day on sports day.
nn: Sjeldan, ja. Sjeldnare enn ein tørr idrettsdag.

en: Ooh, armour. My armour was a padded anorak. Saved me in snowball fights.
nn: Oi, rustning. Mi rustning var ein vatta anorakk. Han berga meg i snøballkrigen.

en: Lovely kit. You'll want a new school bag to match. I had one. Brown.
nn: Fint utstyr. Du vil ha ein ny skulesekk som passar. Eg hadde ein. Brun.

en: That's lovely. Like Christmas morning. Or a new pair of trainers. Same thing.
nn: Det er nydeleg. Som julemorgon. Eller nye joggesko. Same sak.

en: New look! I had a new look every term. Mostly hair.
nn: Ny stil! Eg hadde ny stil kvar termin. Mest håret.

en: Proper gear. I'd have been the envy of 8C. Roger especially.
nn: Skikkeleg utstyr. Eg hadde vore misunt av heile 8C. Særleg Roger.

en: Splendid stuff. Brings back memories of my first pair of real football boots.
nn: Storarta saker. Kallar fram minne om mitt første par ekte fotballsko.

en: A sight for sore eyes. Like the bell at the end of maths.
nn: Ein fryd for auga. Som klokka på slutten av mattetimen.

en: That's lovely. Make sure your mum doesn't wash it. Mine shrank my jumper.
nn: Det er nydeleg. Sjå til at mor di ikkje vaskar det. Mor krympa genseren min.

en: Brilliant kit. If you'd worn that in ninth, you'd have been nearly as cool as me.
nn: Glimrande utstyr. Hadde du hatt det på i niande, hadde du vore nesten like tøff som meg.

en: Gleaming armour. Shines like the gym floor after the caretaker's waxing.
nn: Skinande rustning. Skin som golvet i gymsalen etter at vaktmeisteren har vaksa.

en: Very nice. In my day, the best armour was a thick skin and a cool jacket.
nn: Svært fint. På mi tid var den beste rustninga tjukk hud og ei tøff jakke.

en: Splendid find. Treasure it. Treasure it like I treasure 1976.
nn: Strålande funn. Ta vare på det. Slik eg tek vare på 1976.

en: Oh, that's lush. Lush as the football pitch after rain.
nn: Å, så frodig. Frodig som fotballbana etter regn.

en: That's a fine thing. Like my lucky sweatband. Lucky and sweaty.
nn: Det er fint. Som det heldige svettebåndet mitt. Heldig og sveitt.

en: Good gear. I'd go round the school yard twice in it. Slowly.
nn: Godt utstyr. Eg hadde gått to rundar rundt skulegarden i det. Sakte.

en: Dashing! I dashed too. Sixty metres. Record time.
nn: Flott! Eg flaug òg. Seksti meter. Rekordtid.

en: Armour like that would have got me past the moped crowd.
nn: Slik rustning hadde fått meg forbi mopedgjengen.

en: Proper shine. Like my perm on its first day. Glorious.
nn: Skikkeleg glans. Som permanenten min første dagen. Strålande.

en: A new piece of gear. I'd have spent all my paper-round money on that.
nn: Eit nytt plagg. Eg hadde brukt alle avispengane mine på det.

en: Pure business, that. Like my cup final volley. Perfect.
nn: Reine saker, det der. Som volleyen min i cupfinalen. Perfekt.

en: What a beauty. I'll compare it to my class photo outfit. Close second.
nn: For ein skjønnheit. Eg samanliknar med antrekket mitt på klassebiletet. Godt nummer to.

en: Armour fit for a ninth-grade hero. Which I was.
nn: Rustning som passar for ein helt i niande. Det var eg.

en: I had a jacket like that once. Denim. Patches. Still in the wardrobe.
nn: Eg hadde ei jakke som den ein gong. Dongeri. Merke. Heng framleis i skapet.

en: Mum would have made you keep it for best. Mine stayed for best for years.
nn: Mor hadde sagt at det skulle sparast til stas. Mitt vart spart i årevis.

en: In ninth grade I'd have swapped my whole tape collection for that.
nn: I niande hadde eg bytt heile kassettsamlinga mi for det.

en: Careful you don't outgrow it. I learned that lesson with my best jumper.
nn: Pass på at du ikkje veks frå det. Det lærte eg med den beste genseren min.

en: Roger from 8C would have asked to borrow it. Don't let him.
nn: Roger frå 8C hadde spurt om å få låne det. Ikkje la han.

en: Somewhere, my gym teacher is nodding with approval.
nn: Ein stad nikkar gymlæraren min godkjennande.

en: Ahh, the thrill of new kit. I slept in my football shirt the night before the final.
nn: Åh, spenninga med nytt utstyr. Eg sov i fotballdrakta natta før finalen.

en: If only my class photo had this kind of armour. Just the jumper.
nn: Berre klassebiletet mitt hadde hatt slik rustning. Berre genseren.

en: Wear it with your chin up. That's how I wore my school tie.
nn: Ber det med haka i vêret. Slik bar eg skuleslipset mitt.

en: Gorgeous gear. You'll want to walk the long way round the school yard.
nn: Nydeleg utstyr. Du vil gå den lange vegen rundt skulegarden.

en: Ninth-grade me would have saved up a whole summer for that.
nn: Eg i niande hadde spart heile sommaren for det.

en: I can see it now. You, that armour, the class reunion. Showstopper.
nn: Eg ser det for meg. Du, den rustninga, klassefesten. Blikkfang.

en: Mint condition. Like my football cards. Never traded the good ones.
nn: Som nytt. Som fotballkorta mine. Bytte aldri bort dei gode.

en: Shiny and new. Reminds me of the trophy I lifted in the cup final.
nn: Blankt og nytt. Minner meg om pokalen eg løfta i cupfinalen.

en: Lucky you. My best new gear was a pair of tube socks with stripes.
nn: Heldige deg. Det beste nye plagget mitt var eit par knestrømper med striper.

en: Good heavens, that's smart. Smart enough for the tenth-grade farewell.
nn: Du store, så stilig. Stilig nok til avslutninga i tiande.

en: Even Bente would have said something nice about that. She was hard to please.
nn: Sjølv Bente hadde sagt noko fint om det. Ho var vanskeleg å gjere nøgd.

en: Proper kit for a proper hero. I had proper kit once. Orange.
nn: Skikkeleg utstyr for ein skikkeleg helt. Eg hadde skikkeleg utstyr ein gong. Oransje.

en: Ahh. The feeling of putting on new gym shoes. Nothing else like it.
nn: Åh. Kjensla av å ta på seg nye gymsko. Ingenting liknar.

en: Bet that feels good. My new tracksuit felt like flying. Briefly.
nn: Det kjennest sikkert godt. Den nye treningsdressen min kjendest som å fly. Ei kort stund.

en: Splendid. I'd show it off on the walk home from school. Twice.
nn: Storarta. Eg hadde vist det fram på veg heim frå skulen. To gonger.

en: Dressed like a winner. I know the look. I wore it in 1975.
nn: Kledd som ein vinnar. Eg kjenner stilen. Eg bar han i 1975.

en: You've got an eye for quality. I had an eye for quality cassettes.
nn: Du har auge for kvalitet. Eg hadde auge for kvalitetskassettar.

en: Ooh, the moped crowd would want a closer look at that.
nn: Oi, mopedgjengen hadde villa sjå nærare på det.

en: Picture day ready. Comb your hair, sit up straight, and wear that.
nn: Klar for fotograferingsdagen. Gre håret, sit rakt og ha det på.

en: It's like opening a birthday present in eighth grade. Pure joy.
nn: Det er som å opne ei bursdagsgåve i åttande. Rein glede.

en: A fine addition. My finest addition was a bicycle bell. It rang beautifully.
nn: Eit fint tilskot. Mitt finaste var ei sykkelbjølle. Ho ringde vakkert.

en: Armour! In gym class, our only armour was a thick pair of socks.
nn: Rustning! I gymmen var den einaste rustninga vår eit par tjukke sokkar.

en: Now you just need great hair to go with it. I can advise.
nn: No treng du berre flott hår til. Eg kan gi råd.

en: Remarkable gear. Remarkable as my 60-metre time. Look it up.
nn: Merkverdig bra utstyr. Merkverdig som 60-metertida mi. Sjå sjølv.

en: Sturdy kit. You could climb the gym rope in that. I'd recommend it.
nn: Solid utstyr. Du kunne klatra i tauet i det. Eg tilrår det.

en: Feels like new school shoes squeaking down the corridor, doesn't it?
nn: Kjennest som nye skulesko som knirkar bortetter gangen, ikkje sant?

en: My old denim jacket sighed deeply in the wardrobe. Jealous, I think.
nn: Den gamle dongerijakka mi sukka djupt i skapet. Sjalu, trur eg.

en: Tom-Erik had a jacket almost that nice. Almost. I had the nicer one.
nn: Tom-Erik hadde ei jakke nesten like fin. Nesten. Eg hadde den finaste.

en: Bravo. That outfit deserves a slow walk past the bike rack.
nn: Bravo. Det antrekket fortener ein langsam tur forbi sykkelstativet.

en: In 1976 they'd have stopped the school bus to look at that.
nn: I 1976 hadde dei stoppa skulebussen for å sjå på det.

en: Fancy enough for the student council photo. I'd know.
nn: Fint nok til biletet av elevrådet. Eg veit.

en: Top marks for style. I got top marks in style. Not in maths.
nn: Toppkarakter for stil. Eg fekk toppkarakter i stil. Ikkje i matte.

en: New treasure. I kept my treasures in a biscuit tin under the bed.
nn: Ein ny skatt. Eg hadde skattane mine i ei kakeboks under senga.

en: Hold on to that one. I let my best scarf go on the class trip. Regret.
nn: Hald godt på det. Eg miste det beste skjerfet mitt på klasseturen. Anger.

en: Looking sharp. Sharper than the creases in my gym shorts. Mum ironed them.
nn: Du ser skarp ut. Skarpare enn pressen i gymshortsa mine. Mor strauk dei.

en: Good gracious. Even my perm didn't shine like that.
nn: Du verda. Ikkje ein gong permanenten min skein slik.

en: A cut above. Like me in the 60 metres. Or the class photo.
nn: Eit hakk over. Som eg på 60-meteren. Eller på klassebiletet.

en: Just imagine wearing that to the school disco. Legendary.
nn: Tenk deg å ha det på skulediskoen. Legendarisk.

en: Grand new kit. Grander than my bike with the chopper handlebars.
nn: Flott nytt utstyr. Flottare enn sykkelen min med høgt styre.

en: You'd have got the window seat on the class trip in that.
nn: I det hadde du fått vindaugsplassen på klasseturen.

en: I wore my best kit until it fell apart. Then I wore it some more.
nn: Eg gjekk med det beste utstyret mitt til det datt sund. Så gjekk eg med det litt til.
